title: Your first C program

milestone.title: From Machine Code to Modern Languages

description:
Change the classic program from lesson 5.04 so that it reads two whole numbers and prints:

```
hello, world
7 + 5 = 12
```

for the input `7 5`.

C needs a little more ceremony than Python: every variable has a type (`int` for a whole number), `scanf("%d %d", &a, &b)` reads two numbers into `a` and `b` (the `&` gives `scanf` the variables' addresses so it can fill them in), and `printf` prints with `%d` standing for a number: `printf("%d + %d = %d\n", a, b, a + b);`. Each statement ends with `;`.
